title: Restore shared concurrency for Work Map generated artifacts

phases.objective: Restore the policy-declared shared concurrency key for every Spec Kit Work Map writer while preserving exact-head and protected-branch guards.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The Spec Kit Work Map Autofix workflow is evaluated as a writer of docs/work-maps generated artifacts.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The workflow uses the exact shared resource concurrency expression, does not cancel an active writer, and retains bounded work-branch publication guards.
steps: Read the Work Map Autofix workflow from the exact candidate tree.
Require the policy-declared shared concurrency expression for dispatch and authorized pull-request contexts.
Retain exact remote-head verification, protected-branch rejection, and non-force work-branch publication.
Execute Automation Overlap Guard and the focused concurrency regression.
assertions: The dispatch-only concurrency key is absent.
The exact policy-declared shared resource concurrency key is present.
In-progress mutation runs are not cancelled.
main and Production remain invalid mutation targets.
Remote branch head must equal expected_head_sha before publication.
No provider call, deployment, database mutation, migration Apply, Production mutation, external send, or force push is introduced.

phases.objective: Verify the overlap analyzer reports no critical resource-group concurrency mismatch.
Reject future divergence from the canonical generated-artifact writer concurrency key.
Prove exact-head Draft and Ready workflow cycles.
Confirm main retains the canonical concurrency expression after merge.
